parsed.why: Adds protected facilities access, 2001 gender-identity hate-crime coverage, care sanctuary; but no identity-based custody rule and a 2024 consent decree over violence and denied care in men's prisons, plus pending 2026 ballot restrictions, cap it.

Public-accommodations law covering hotels and transport, enforced by a body that investigates and grants relief; safest recorded per-capita violence, surgery-free markers, care sanctuary; no documented state-level exposure beyond the national border regime.

Broad anti-discrimination including accommodations and hospital visitation, a shield law against out-of-state warrants and custody orders, panic defence barred; only state exposure is a dated 2012 men's-prison placement case.

Court-protected facilities access, 2024 sanctuary law, strongest trans-health coverage, anti-discrimination and hate-crime coverage; two recent city killings are raw counts lacking denominators, so violence carries little weight.

Adds its own hostile layer: birth-sex facility bans, sex defined by birth, a refusal-of-service religious-liberties statute, no gender-identity hate-crime or anti-discrimination coverage; sits below the parent line.
